BrochureContent.Content:
An attractive four-bedroom detached bungalow extending to approximately 138 sq. m. (1,485 sq. ft.), set on a substantial 0.79-acre site and offering generous accommodation together with excellent outdoor space.

The subject property enjoys a highly convenient location, set on mature grounds with beautiful gardens. The property has impressive kerb appeal and is ideally situated just minutes from Skibbereen town centre.

It is a distinctive and thoughtfully designed single-storey residence, constructed to an exceptionally high standard for its era and presented in good condition throughout. The accommodation is both spacious and well laid out, comprising a Hall with Terrazo floor, Living Room, Kitchen/Dining room, four generously proportioned double bedrooms and a family bathroom. There is a loft which offers further accomodation .

An integrated garage/workshop, with double doors opening onto the garden, further enhances the property’s practicality and appeal.

A wonderful driveway, flanked by mature gardens and hedging, provides ample private parking. A garden gazebo offers an ideal space to relax and enjoy the surrounding garden. The property also benefits from two separate vehicular entrances, providing convenient separate entrance and exit.

The N71 National Road can be accessed easily from the property which connects Cork City with Bandon, Clonakilty, Skibbereen and all the way west to Kenmare in Co. Kerry. It is only a couple of minutes from Skibbereen Town Centre. Cork International Airport is just over an hour away.

The vibrant heritage town of Skibbereen is a thriving market town in the heart of West Cork, renowned for its welcoming community and excellent range of amenities. The town offers a selection of schools, healthcare services, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, hotels, independent shops, a market, and a wide variety of local businesses, catering for everyday needs and providing a strong community atmosphere.

Skibbereen is ideally positioned to enjoy all that West Cork has to offer, with a spectacular coastline, beautiful beaches and a wealth of scenic destinations within easy reach. Nearby attractions include Tragumna Beach, Lough Hyne, Barleycove, Crookhaven, Baltimore, Castletownshend, The Warren Beach and the stunning coastal landscapes of the Mizen and Sheep’s Head Peninsulas. The area also offers numerous scenic walking routes, coastal trails and opportunities to enjoy the exceptional natural beauty for which West Cork is renowned.
